name: Typewriter
description: Types and deletes a rotating list of words after a static prefix, with configurable typing speed, hold pause, accent color, and a blinking caret.
a11yNotes: A visually hidden span announces the prefix and the full word list once; the character-by-character output and caret are aria-hidden so screen readers are not spammed. Under prefers-reduced-motion the first word is shown statically with a steady caret.

propsApi.name: words
propsApi.description: Words typed and deleted in sequence.

propsApi.name: prefix
propsApi.description: Static text rendered before the typed word.

propsApi.name: speed
propsApi.description: Milliseconds per typed character; deleting runs twice as fast.

propsApi.name: pause
propsApi.description: Milliseconds to hold a completed word before deleting.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Color of the typed word and caret.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
